days.title: Concurrency & Thread Safety

items.text: `synchronized` vs `ReentrantLock` vs `Mutex` — trade-offs, and why you cannot use `synchronized` around a suspend call.
Define race condition, data race, deadlock, livelock and starvation. Give a concrete example of each.
Two parallel requests withdraw money from the same account at the same time. Walk me through the race and fix it. *(прямая формулировка из отчётов о Revolut)*
What does `@Volatile` guarantee — and what does it explicitly NOT guarantee?
What is the happens-before relationship in the JMM? Give an example using `volatile`.
How do you prevent deadlock in `transfer(from, to, amount)` between two accounts? *(lock ordering — проговори явно)*
Optimistic vs pessimistic locking — model an account transfer with both. Which would you ship in a bank and why?
What is CAS? How do `AtomicInteger` / `AtomicReference` use it, and when does CAS perform badly?
Explain double-checked locking and why `volatile` is required for correctness.
`ConcurrentHashMap` vs `Collections.synchronizedMap` — what is actually different?
Why are unbounded thread pools dangerous? How do you size a pool for CPU-bound vs IO-bound work?
Explain the Android main thread machinery: `Looper`, `MessageQueue`, `Handler`, `Choreographer`.

days.prose:
**Почему первый.** Это документированный фильтр Revolut. В отзывах кандидатов и в гайдах по процессу конкурентность названа отдельно как то, на чём отсеивают Java/Kotlin-кандидатов. У Monzo в system design грилят по concurrency / consistency / network faults. Ни один другой блок не даёт такой плотности отказов.
Учить **до автоматизма** — не «знаю определение», а «пишу корректный код под таймером и вслух объясняю, почему он корректен».

weeks.title: Live Coding / LLD

days.title: Live Coding / LLD

items.text: **Thread-safe in-memory account ledger**: `deposit`, `withdraw`, `transfer`. No deadlocks. With unit tests.
**In-memory load balancer** with pluggable strategies (round-robin, weighted, least-connections) + register/unregister. Thread-safe.
**Rate limiter** — implement fixed window, then sliding window, then token bucket. Thread-safe. *(named by Monzo candidates too)*
**Currency conversion engine**: rate table, cross-rates, stale-rate handling.
**LRU cache with TTL**, O(1), thread-safe.
**Request deduplication cache**: same key → one in-flight call, all callers receive the result.

**Fix a broken app.** You inherit a half-finished screen with crashes, a memory leak and unfinished design. Get it to spec inside the timebox, narrating trade-offs. *(буквально описанный сценарий Monzo take-home)*
**Retry executor** with exponential backoff, jitter and cancellation.
**Task scheduler** running at most N tasks concurrently, preserving submission order per key.
Convert a callback-based repository to coroutines **without breaking existing callers**.

days.prose:
**Формат раунда:** 45–60 минут, 2–3 задачи подряд, свой IDE, часто без Copilot и без поиска. Требования: **работающий код + юнит-тесты + thread safety by default + SOLID**. Главная причина провала — кандидаты относятся к раунду как к спортивному программированию вместо инженерной задачи. Take-home без тестов у Revolut описывается как автоматический отказ.
**Тренируй с таймером и вслух.** Работающее решение с тестами бьёт элегантное без тестов.

weeks.note: **Правило для 2.7 и 2.10.** Monzo прямо просит уложиться в таймбокс и показать осознанные компромиссы, а не идеальное решение за выходные. На разборе решения нужно **защищать ключевые решения** и честно говорить, что сделал бы иначе при большем времени. Готовь эту формулировку заранее.

weeks.title: Coroutines & Flow

days.title: Coroutines & Flow

items.text: What is structured concurrency and what concrete problems does it eliminate?
`launch` vs `async` vs `withContext` — return type, exception behaviour, dispatch.
`Job` vs `SupervisorJob`; `coroutineScope {}` vs `supervisorScope {}` — how does exception propagation differ?
Why is cancellation cooperative, and what does that mean for your code?
Cold vs hot: `Flow`, `SharedFlow`, `StateFlow`, `Channel` — compare semantics.
What exactly does `SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000)` do, and why 5 seconds?
`Mutex` vs `synchronized` — and how do you deduplicate in-flight requests so five simultaneous callers trigger one network call?
A network call is in flight when `onCleared()` is called. What happens to the coroutine? To the HTTP request? To the OkHttp thread?
Why doesn't `try { launch { throw ... } } catch (e: Exception) {}` catch anything?
`async {}` throws and you never call `await()`. Where does the exception go?
A parent is cancelled while a child is inside a `finally` block that calls a suspend function. What happens?
Name three concrete production failures caused by `GlobalScope.launch` inside a ViewModel.
Does marking a function `suspend` guarantee it won't block the main thread?
`while (true) { doWork() }` inside a coroutine — is it cancellable? How do you fix it?
`MutableStateFlow` is assigned an equal value twice. How many emissions do collectors see? Why?
`_state.value.items.add(newItem)` where `items` is a `MutableList` — does the UI update? Why not?
A navigation event is emitted into a `SharedFlow(replay = 0)` before the screen subscribes. What happens, and how do you fix it *properly*?
Two collectors subscribe to the same cold `Flow` from a Retrofit call. How many network requests fire?
An exception is thrown inside `collect {}`. Is upstream cancelled? Does `catch {}` intercept it? What changes if `catch {}` is placed before vs after `map {}`?
`stateIn` requires an initial value. What are the two standard ways to model "nothing loaded yet", and what's wrong with `null`?

Why is `StateFlow` a poor fit for one-off events (navigation, snackbar)? Walk through `Channel` vs `SharedFlow` vs state-driven event, and the lifecycle race in each. *(живой спор в комьюнити — сильный ответ обязателен для senior)*
What is a coroutine at the bytecode level? Explain CPS transformation and `Continuation`.
How do you make a blocking third-party call cancellable?
How does `CoroutineExceptionHandler` work, and why doesn't it catch exceptions from `async`?
`Main` vs `Main.immediate` vs `Default` vs `IO` — thread pools, sizing, use cases. What problem does `limitedParallelism` solve?
What does "main-safe suspend function" mean, and whose responsibility is main-safety?
How do you inject dispatchers so the code stays testable?
`runBlocking` vs `runTest`; how does `runTest` handle virtual time and delay skipping?
`map` vs `flatMapLatest` vs `flatMapMerge` vs `flatMapConcat` — a real use case for each.
`combine` vs `zip` — behaviour with different emission rates.
`collect` vs `collectLatest` — what exactly gets cancelled?
What does `flowOn` change, and why does it only affect upstream operators?
How do `callbackFlow` and `channelFlow` work, and why is `awaitClose` mandatory?
Wrap a callback-based API in `suspendCancellableCoroutine`. What must you handle?
`repeatOnLifecycle` vs `flowWithLifecycle` vs `launchWhenStarted` — what is deprecated and why?
How do you test a Flow? Show the Turbine approach for a `SharedFlow`.
You're already on `Dispatchers.IO` and call `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`. Does a thread switch happen?
`Dispatchers.IO` and `Dispatchers.Default` share threads. What does that imply for a CPU-heavy task launched on IO?
`WhileSubscribed(5000)` vs `Eagerly` vs `Lazily` — what does the user actually see on rotation for each?
`.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)` placed after `.collect {}` — does it do anything? And `combine(a, b)` where `b` hasn't emitted yet — does downstream receive anything?
`distinctUntilChanged()` on a data class holding a `List` — does it reliably deduplicate?
`lifecycleScope.launch { flow.collect {} }` in `onCreate` — what exactly leaks, and when?

days.prose: **Самый вероятный технический deep-dive для Android-роли** и одновременно топливо для блока 1. Разделено на теорию и gotcha-вопросы — вторые ценнее, там сеньоры и валятся.

weeks.note: Формат: тебе дают сниппет и спрашивают «что выведется» / «что здесь баг». Это **самый ценный подраздел всего файла**: тут ты «знаешь тему», но отвечаешь неправильно.

days.title: Защита своей архитектуры (раунд по ABM)

items.text: Walk me through the architecture of the app you work on. *(3 минуты, без бумажки, на английском)*
Why is it structured that way? What would you change if you started today?
**Someone looking at your app might say it's over-engineered. What would you say to that?** *(реально задавали на Monzo — это не троллинг, это проверка, умеешь ли обосновывать, а не оправдываться)*
How many modules do you have, what is the actual build time, and what have you done about it?
Which part of the codebase are you least happy with, and why haven't you fixed it?
What's your test strategy, honestly — what is tested and what isn't?
What's the hardest bug you've debugged there? Walk me through the investigation.
Tell me about a big technical challenge you overcame, and how you influenced stakeholders around it. *(дословно то, что Monzo указывает как содержание первого звонка)*
How do you handle a feature that touches four teams' modules?
What does your release process look like, and what's the worst thing that ever shipped?
If I gave you two weeks and no product work, what would you fix first?
How is your app different from a non-banking app — what does the domain force you to do?

days.prose:
**Самый высокий ROI на час подготовки во всём файле.** Это отдельный раунд у Monzo (первый часовой звонок — разбор недавнего сложного проекта, кода не пишешь), у N26 (deep dive, где два senior-инженера заставляют защищать каждое решение), у Wise (разбор take-home). Ты уже знаешь материал — нужно только отрепетировать формулировки на английском.
**Заготовь три истории по ABM**, каждая на 3 минуты, каждая с цифрами:
1. Сложная фича с trade-offs.
2. Инцидент/баг с расследованием.
3. Архитектурное решение, которое продавил — или проиграл.

days.title: Architecture & Modularization

items.text: Single state class vs multiple flows for a screen — defend your choice. *(N26 отклонял take-home именно за отдельные потоки под error / loading / result)*
How do you model loading / error / empty / content without a combinatorial explosion of states?
MVVM vs MVI vs MVP — what do you actually gain from MVI, and what does it cost?
Clean Architecture: what belongs in the domain layer? When is a UseCase layer just ceremony?
Where do you map DTO → entity → domain → UI models, and why there?
What problem does an `api`/`impl` module split solve, and how do you wire it with Hilt?
How do you enforce module dependency rules mechanically rather than at code review?
Hilt components and scopes, `@Binds` vs `@Provides`, multibindings — how do you provide a feature-scoped dependency?
How do you structure navigation in a multi-module app so features don't depend on each other?
How do you evolve a public module API without breaking 30 consumers?
How would you incrementally migrate a legacy XML/MVP app to Compose/MVI without freezing the roadmap?
How do you architect for feature flags, and how do you avoid flag debt?

days.prose: Твоя домашняя территория (ABM: multi-module, MVI, Hilt, api/impl, convention plugins). Держи ⭐⭐ там, где N26 реально резал кандидатов.

weeks.title: Mobile System Design

days.title: Mobile System Design

items.text: Design a transactions/statements screen covering ten years of history.
Design a money transfer flow, including retries, idempotency and failure states.
Design an offline-first sync engine: scheduling, backoff, conflicts, battery.
Design a photo/video upload pipeline that survives process death. *(вариант: KYC onboarding с загрузкой документов и резюмируемыми шагами)*
Design a chat app with offline support, read receipts and message ordering.
Design an Instagram-style / ranked feed client.
Design a multi-currency balance screen updating in real time over WebSocket: throttling, ordering, stale data.
Design push notification handling: deduplication, deep links, foreground vs background.
Design a client-side analytics SDK: batching, offline buffering, sampling, privacy.
Design a feature-flag and remote-config client.

days.prose:
**Отдельный раунд у Monzo** (час, два мобильных инженера, виртуальная доска Excalidraw, кода не пишешь кроме моделей данных и интерфейсов). Тебе дают **UI-дизайн + начальные требования** и просят blueprint end-to-end реализации — такой, чтобы по нему можно было начать писать вместе. Оценивают: удержание общего понимания с интервьюером и проактивное снятие неоднозначности. У N26 и Bolt тоже отдельный system design раунд.
**Важно:** в отчётах по Revolut отмечают, что в system design ценили **операционный workflow больше, чем красивую общую диаграмму**. Не рисуй схему — рассказывай, как это работает в проде. И почти всегда просят **и клиент, и контракт API** — не застревай в Android-слое.

framework: **Clarify scope** — одна фича или всё приложение? Платформы? Офлайн нужен? Real-time или pull-to-refresh?
**Non-functional requirements** — latency, офлайн, батарея, память, безопасность, доступность, локализация.
**High-level client architecture** — слои, модули, поток данных.
**API contract & data model** — форма пагинации, размер payload, версионирование.
**Caching & sync** — single source of truth, инвалидация, разрешение конфликтов.
**Threading & concurrency** — что где выполняется, что отменяемо.
**Edge cases & failure modes** — нет сети, медленная сеть, process death, частичный отказ, clock skew.
**Observability** — метрики, логи, crash reporting, на что бы алертил.
**Trade-offs и что сделал бы иначе на 10× масштабе.**

days.title: Data, Networking & Offline

items.text: What is idempotency, and why does a payment request need an idempotency key?
How do you guarantee a "send money" action executes exactly once from the client's point of view?
Implement token refresh when five parallel requests all return 401 simultaneously.
Conflict resolution: last-write-wins, version vectors, server authority — which fits a bank and why?
Design optimistic UI with rollback — first for a "like", then for a money transfer. What changes?
OkHttp application vs network interceptors — where do auth, retry and logging belong?
How do you map HTTP, network and parsing failures into a single domain error model?
WebSocket vs SSE vs long polling vs FCM push — pick one for live balance updates and justify it.
Cursor-based vs offset pagination — why does it matter for a transactions list?
Room migrations: what happens when one is missing, and how do you test migrations?
Certificate pinning bypasses the device trust store — what is the operational cost, and how do you avoid bricking the app on rotation?
Encrypting local data: SQLCipher, `EncryptedSharedPreferences`, Keystore-backed keys — trade-offs.

days.prose: Это топливо для блока 6. Каждый вопрос отсюда — потенциальный follow-up в system design.

days.title: Jetpack Compose

items.text: Explain the three phases: composition, layout, drawing. Which phase should you avoid doing work in?
What is a recompose scope, and why can a whole screen recompose because of one state read?

**What is strong skipping mode and what changed?** Unstable параметры теперь сравниваются по instance equality (`===`), лямбды с unstable-захватами авто-мемоизируются, а большинство ручных `@Stable`/`@Immutable` стали мёртвым грузом — они нужны только там, где требуется сравнение по `equals()`. Знать это точно: тема свежая, и на ней ловят тех, кто выучил старые правила стабильности.
How do you diagnose excessive recomposition? (Layout Inspector counts, compiler reports, composition tracing.)
`@Stable` vs `@Immutable` — what is the contract, and what happens if you lie to the compiler?
`remember` vs `rememberSaveable` — what survives what? How do you write a custom `Saver`?
What problem does `derivedStateOf` solve, and what is the most common misuse? What's the defect if it's written without `remember`?
Give a use case for each: `LaunchedEffect`, `DisposableEffect`, `SideEffect`, `rememberCoroutineScope`, `rememberUpdatedState`, `snapshotFlow`.
`LaunchedEffect(Unit)` sits inside an `if (condition)` branch that toggles. How many times does the effect run?
`rememberCoroutineScope()` vs `LaunchedEffect` — give a case where the wrong one is a bug, not a style choice.
Why do `key`s matter in a `LazyColumn` for state and animation correctness? `mutableStateListOf` vs `mutableStateOf(listOf())`?
`LazyColumn` performance: keys, `contentType`, item stability, nested scrolling pitfalls.
What is a baseline profile, roughly what does it buy you on cold start, and how do you generate one?
State hoisting and UDF — how do you structure a screen with 20 interactive fields without a god-object state?

How does the Navigation Compose back stack work? What does Navigation 3 change conceptually (`NavKey`, `NavDisplay`, `SceneStrategy`, `EntryProvider`)? How do you scope a ViewModel to a nav graph or a single destination?
Edge-to-edge is enforced now — how do you handle window insets, including IME insets, in Compose?

days.prose: Compose — уже не опция, а дефолт; интервьюеры на mid/senior спрашивают про него системно. Но глубина спроса ниже, чем по корутинам: тебя проверяют на понимание **рекомпозиции и стабильности**, а не на знание всех API.

days.title: ViewModel, Lifecycle & State

items.text: Process death vs configuration change — how do they differ, and how do you *actually* test process death on a device?
`onSaveInstanceState` vs `SavedStateHandle` vs `ViewModel` — what survives what? What can you put in `SavedStateHandle`, and what's the practical size limit?
What happens to `viewModelScope` in `onCleared()`, and what does NOT get cancelled?
Walk through the full Activity lifecycle on rotation. What changes with `android:configChanges`?
What is the practical `Bundle` size limit, and how do you avoid `TransactionTooLargeException`?
Is there ever a safe way for a ViewModel to hold a `Context`? Which `Context` types leak and why?
Passing a screen argument into a ViewModel: assisted injection vs `SavedStateHandle` — when is each correct?
A singleton holds an Activity `Context`. How long does the leak last, and what exactly is retained?
LiveData vs StateFlow for a state holder — argue both sides, then pick one.

days.prose: Плотный gotcha-блок. Спрашивают почти везде, потому что дёшево проверить и хорошо разделяет middle от senior.

days.title: Testing

items.text: In a 60-minute live coding round with TDD, what do you write first and why?
`StandardTestDispatcher` vs `UnconfinedTestDispatcher`, `advanceUntilIdle`, `runCurrent` — when does each matter?
How do you make a ViewModel fully unit-testable?
Mocks verify interactions, stubs return canned responses, fakes are simplified working implementations — when do you use each, and why do seniors lean towards fakes?
How do you test a `SharedFlow` of one-off events with Turbine? And a state holder using `stateIn(WhileSubscribed)`?
Describe your testing pyramid for a banking app, concretely.
What makes UI tests flaky, and what are your five standard fixes?
How do you test logic that depends on time, dates and timezones?
What is your position on code coverage as a target metric?

days.prose: Не факультатив. У Revolut отправка take-home без тестов описывается как автоматический отказ; в live coding ждут юнит-тесты внутри таймбокса.

days.title: Performance & Diagnostics

items.text: Crash-free rate dropped from 99.8% to 99.1% overnight. Walk me through your response, minute by minute.
Walk through cold, warm and hot start. How do you measure startup properly (Macrobenchmark, `reportFullyDrawn`, Play Vitals)?
Cold start regressed by 400 ms after a release. Walk me through finding the cause.
What causes jank? Explain the frame lifecycle and the budget at 60 Hz vs 120 Hz. How do you diagnose jank with Perfetto?
An ANR happens when the main thread is blocked too long — how does the system detect it, and how do you debug one from Play Console data alone?
Memory leak vs memory churn vs fragmentation — how do the symptoms differ? How does LeakCanary detect a leak, and what are typical leak sources in a Compose codebase?
How do you approach a performance issue you cannot reproduce locally?
What does R8 actually do? How do you debug a crash that only reproduces in a minified release build?

days.prose: Твоя сильная зона — здесь нужны истории из ABM с цифрами, а не теория.

days.title: Kotlin & JVM

items.text: What does `inline` change in the generated bytecode, and when does inlining hurt? What problems do `noinline` and `crossinline` solve? Why does `reified` only work inside `inline`?
How are `equals`/`hashCode` generated for a `data class`? A `data class` with a `var` field is put in a `HashSet`, then the field is mutated — what happens on `contains()`?
`sealed class` vs `sealed interface` vs `enum` for UI state. What breaks at compile time vs runtime when you add a new subtype vs a new enum constant?
How does `by lazy` work internally? What are the three `LazyThreadSafetyMode` options? `lateinit` vs `by lazy` vs nullable — trade-offs.
What thread-safety guarantees does a Kotlin `object` give for its initialization, and how many instances exist in a multi-process app?
Explain declaration-site vs use-site variance (`in`, `out`, star projection) with an example from a repository API. What is type erasure and how do you work around it?
How would you model domain errors: exceptions, `Result`, or a sealed error type? Defend the choice.
What is a value class (`@JvmInline`)? When does it still get boxed at runtime?
`Sequence` vs `List` operator chains — when does `Sequence` actually win?
Complexity of `ArrayList` vs `LinkedList` vs `HashMap` for insert/lookup/delete — and when does `HashMap` degrade? What breaks if `equals` is implemented without `hashCode`?
Why are extension functions statically dispatched, and what surprising behaviour does that cause?
Walk through SOLID, one letter at a time, with an example from a real codebase. Why "composition over inheritance", and when is inheritance still the right call?

days.prose: Базовый слой. Спрашивают на скрине и как follow-up внутри других блоков — редко как отдельный раунд. Поэтому все ⭐, ни одного ⭐⭐: провалить один такой вопрос обычно не фатально, но провалить пять подряд — фатально.

days.title: Android Platform

items.text: **Google Play requires targetSdk 36 for new apps and updates from 31 August 2026.** What breaks when you bump: edge-to-edge can no longer be opted out of, `onBackPressed()` stops firing, apps on screens 600dp+ can no longer lock orientation or aspect ratio, and 16 KB page-size support is required for native libraries. Walk me through how you'd plan and QA that migration. *(идеальный вопрос для «что ты сделал недавно» — подготовь ответ по ABM)*
What is the predictive back gesture, and what does adding proper support to an existing app require?
WorkManager vs Foreground Service vs AlarmManager vs JobScheduler — give a decision matrix. How does WorkManager guarantee execution across process death and reboot?
What changed with mandatory foreground service types and restricted exact alarms? How do Doze mode and App Standby buckets affect a background sync feature?
Deep links vs App Links — how do you verify an App Link, debug failed verification, and prevent deep link hijacking?
Runtime permissions: one-time grants, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, the photo picker and partial media access. How does the current photo/video model differ from SDK 33?
How does the system decide to kill your process? Explain `onTrimMemory` and importance levels.
Trace the build pipeline: sources → dex → APK/AAB → install → ART. Where do AOT, JIT and profile-guided compilation fit?
Explain Binder IPC. What happens when an `Intent` crosses a process boundary?
How would you support a device with no Google Play Services in a banking app?

days.prose: Отобрано по принципу «спросят у senior в 2026», а не «есть в учебнике». Первый вопрос — новый, его не было в исходном банке: он актуален прямо сейчас.

days.title: Security (fintech)

items.text: Where do you store an auth token, and why not in SharedPreferences?
The Android Keystore keeps keys inside the TEE or StrongBox — what guarantee do you actually get, and what do you *not*? What does hardware key attestation prove to your backend?
`BiometricPrompt` with a `CryptoObject` — why does binding a key to biometrics matter?
Pinning can be defeated by hooking on a rooted device — so what is the realistic role of root and hook detection?
Walk through a pre-release security checklist: R8, HTTPS-only, `FLAG_SECURE`, `allowBackup`, exported components, no hardcoded secrets, dependency audit.
Session management: idle timeout, step-up re-authentication, background screenshot blur.
You're reviewing a PR that touches the payments flow. What specifically are you looking for?

days.prose: Не отдельный раунд, но всплывает в system design, в разборе твоего проекта и в вопросах про платёжный флоу. Держи семь заготовленных ответов.

weeks.title: Behavioral

days.title: Behavioral

items.text: Tell me about yourself. *(2 минуты, отрепетированные, без филлеров)*
**What were your key achievements and your low points in your last role?** *(прямая формулировка из плейбука Bar Raiser — будут копать на 2–3 слоя вглубь по каждому пункту)*
Walk me through the most complex feature you shipped end to end.
Tell me about a technical decision you later regretted.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager or tech lead.
Tell me about a production incident you caused or fixed. What changed afterwards?
Tell me about delivering with unclear or shifting requirements.
Give an example of pushing back on scope or a deadline.
Describe convincing others to adopt an approach they initially resisted.
Tell me about the largest migration or refactor you led. How did you de-risk it?
Tell me about mentoring someone. What concretely changed for them?
Tell me about receiving hard feedback — and about a time you were wrong and a colleague was right.
Tell me about a metric you moved. How did you measure it?
How do you think about the trade-off between shipping speed, security and quality? *(N26 оценивает это по рубрике)*
Why are you leaving your current role? Why this company? What does "senior" mean to you beyond writing code?

days.prose:
**Не недооценивай этот блок.** У Revolut Bar Raiser — часовой финальный раунд, отдельно сертифицированный интервьюер, который копает **на 2–3 слоя вглубь** по каждому достижению. По опубликованному плейбуку: ждут амбиции, честности, высокого темпа; готовности назвать слабости **с доказательством, что ты над ними работал**; количественных достижений. Тот же интервьюер потом делает reference call по тем же темам — расхождения между твоим рассказом и рефересами видны. Плюс сигнал считается плохим, если текущий работодатель не пытался тебя удержать.
У Monzo — час, два интервьюера, **четыре вопроса** про коммуникацию, обучение, работу в команде и доставку проектов; интервьюеры могут быть не мобильными, поэтому контекст объясняй с нуля. У N26 — оценка по рубрике trade-off между скоростью, безопасностью и качеством.
**Правила:** говори «я», а не «мы» — иначе теряется сигнал о личном вкладе. Держи цифры: ответы без метрик читаются как отсутствие ownership. Шести–восьми историй хватает на всё.

weeks.note: **Матрица покрытия.** Проверь, что 6–8 историй закрывают: ownership · conflict · failure · ambiguity · influence · mentorship · prioritization · delivery under pressure · incident response · cross-functional work.

Narrating code while writing it during live coding. *(отдельно тренируй — это неестественно)*
Asking for clarification: *"Just to make sure I understand correctly — are you asking about X or Y?"*
Buying time: *"Let me think about that for a second."*
Disagreeing politely: *"I see it differently, and here's why."*
Admitting a gap: *"I haven't worked with that directly, but based on how X works, I'd expect…"*
What does the mobile release process look like end to end, and how do compliance constraints affect it?
